Message.Name: UTP Quote Short-form Message
Message.Description: Short-format UTP Quotation Message. Used to disseminate quotation data for NASDAQ listed securities. To be retired with the Odd Lot Release on April 27, 2026.

Field.Name: Market Center Originator
Field.Description: UTP participant or system that originated the message

Field.Name: Sub-Market Center ID
Field.Description: Used for reporting trades originated by FINRA ADF or a FINRA TRF

Field.Name: SIP Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the outbound message is produced by the SIP, nanoseconds since Epoch

Field.Name: Participant Token
Field.Description: Participant Token. Intended for UTP SIP internal use only

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: Bid Size, in number of actual shares

Field.Name: Ask Size
Field.Description: Ask Size, in number of actual shares

Field.Name: SIP Generated Update Flag
Field.Description: Indicates if the message is the result of a SIP-generated transaction

Message.Name: UTP Quote Long-form Message
Message.Description: Long-format UTP Quotation Message. To be retired with the Odd Lot Release on April 27, 2026.

Field.Name: Market Center Originator
Field.Description: UTP participant or system that originated the message

Field.Name: Sub-Market Center ID
Field.Description: Used for reporting trades originated by FINRA ADF or a FINRA TRF

Field.Name: SIP Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the outbound message is produced by the SIP, nanoseconds since Epoch

Field.Name: Timestamp2
Field.Description: FINRA Timestamp, nanoseconds since Epoch. Set to 0 if from an exchange

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: Bid Size, in number of actual shares

Field.Name: Ask Size
Field.Description: Ask Size, in number of actual shares

Message.Name: FINRA ADF Market Participant Quotation Message
Message.Description: FINRA ADF Quotation Message. Sent for FINRA quotes that do not affect the NBBO or FINRA BBO. May also be produced when the FINRA BBO quote impacts either the current FINRA best bid or best ask.

Field.Name: Market Center Originator
Field.Description: UTP participant or system that originated the message

Field.Name: Sub-Market Center ID
Field.Description: Used for reporting trades originated by FINRA ADF or a FINRA TRF

Field.Name: SIP Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the outbound message is produced by the SIP, nanoseconds since Epoch

Field.Name: Timestamp2
Field.Description: FINRA Timestamp, nanoseconds since Epoch. Set to 0 if not provided

Message.Name: Combined Quote Message Short Form Message
Message.Description: Short Format Combined Quotation Message. Combines protected quote and one or more odd lot quotes in a single message. Introduced with the Odd Lot Release on April 27, 2026.

Field.Name: Market Center Originator
Field.Description: UTP participant or system that originated the message

Field.Name: Protected Bid Price
Field.Description: Protected Bid Price, 2 implied decimal places

Field.Name: Protected Ask Price
Field.Description: Protected Ask Price, 2 implied decimal places

Field.Name: Odd Lot Attachment Count
Field.Description: Number of odd lot price levels included in the attachment

Message.Name: Combined Quote Message Long Form Message
Message.Description: Long-format Combined Quotation Message. Combines protected quote and one or more odd lot quotes in a single message. Introduced with the Odd Lot Release on April 27, 2026.

Field.Name: Market Center Originator
Field.Description: UTP participant or system that originated the message

Field.Name: Protected Bid Price
Field.Description: Protected Bid Price, 6 implied decimal places

Field.Name: Protected Ask Price
Field.Description: Protected Ask Price, 6 implied decimal places

Field.Name: Odd Lot Attachment Count
Field.Description: Number of odd lot price levels included in the attachment

Message.Name: Odd Lot Quote Message Short Form Message
Message.Description: Short Format Odd Lot Quotation Message. Contains one or more odd lots without a protected quote change. Introduced with the Odd Lot Release on April 27, 2026.

Field.Name: Market Center Originator
Field.Description: UTP participant or system that originated the message

Field.Name: Odd Lot Attachment Count
Field.Description: Number of odd lot price levels included in the attachment

Message.Name: Odd Lot Quote Message Long Form Message
Message.Description: Long Format Odd Lot Quotation Message. Contains one or more odd lots without a protected quote change. Introduced with the Odd Lot Release on April 27, 2026.

Field.Name: Market Center Originator
Field.Description: UTP participant or system that originated the message

Field.Name: Odd Lot Attachment Count
Field.Description: Number of odd lot price levels included in the attachment

Message.Name: General Administrative Message
Message.Description: General Administrative Message containing free-form text

Field.Name: Market Center Originator
Field.Description: UTP participant or system that originated the message

Field.Name: Text Length
Field.Description: Length of the variable Text field

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Administrative text; variable-length, sized by Text Length

Message.Name: CROSS SRO Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Informs subscribers of trading actions (halts, pauses, quotation resumptions and trading resumptions) impacting the trading of a NASDAQ-listed issue across all UTP participants

Field.Name: Trading Action Sequence Number
Field.Description: Trading Action Sequence Number (UTP SIP internal use only)

Field.Name: Action Time
Field.Description: Timestamp of when the action occurred

Message.Name: Market Center Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Informs UTP data feed subscribers when a UTP participant invokes or releases a market center-specific trading halt for a NASDAQ-listed security

Field.Name: Action Time
Field.Description: Timestamp of when the action occurred

Message.Name: Issue Symbol Directory Message
Message.Description: Issue Symbol Directory Message providing reference data for NASDAQ-listed securities

Message.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message
Message.Description: Reg SHO Restriction Indicator Message indicating the Rule 201 status for NASDAQ-listed securities

Message.Name: Limit Up Limit Down Price Band Message
Message.Description: LULD Price Band Message containing the Limit Up-Limit Down price bands for a NASDAQ-listed security

Field.Name: Limit Down Price
Field.Description: Limit Down Price, 6 implied decimal places

Field.Name: Limit Up Price
Field.Description: Limit Up Price, 6 implied decimal places

Message.Name: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Decline Level Message
Message.Description: MWCB Decline Message informing participants and UTP data recipients of the daily MWCB breach points

Message.Name: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Status Message
Message.Description: MWCB Status Message informing participants when a MWCB has breached one of the established levels

Message.Name: Auction Collar Message
Message.Description: Auction Collar Message published by primary markets using an automated reopening to communicate auction collars after a LULD Trading Pause

Field.Name: Collar Reference Price
Field.Description: Reference price used to set collar

Field.Name: Collar Extension Indicator
Field.Description: Collar Extension Indicator (0-255). Resets to 0 on each new pause event

Message.Name: Session Close Recap Message
Message.Description: Session Close Recap Message reflecting the National BBO quotation information at the close of the normal market session, with attachments for each UTP participant's most recent quote update

Message.Name: Start Of Day Message
Message.Description: Signifies the beginning of each operational cycle for SIP Processing

Message.Name: End Of Day Message
Message.Description: Signals the end of active message dissemination for the UTP SIP operational cycle

Message.Name: Market Session Open Message
Message.Description: Signifies the opening of market systems for the session indicated in the Message Header

Message.Name: Market Session Close Message
Message.Description: Signals the closing of market systems for the session indicated in the Message Header

Message.Name: End of Transmissions Message
Message.Description: Signals that there will be no further transmissions of data sent through the UTP SIP line. Transmitted at the end of the day and will be the last message of the day

Message.Name: Quote Wipe-Out Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate that a UTP Participant is experiencing a problem with their internal systems and is unable to update their UTP BBO quotation information. Disseminated only when a UTP participant is requesting the SIP to remove its quote from ALL NASDAQ-listed securities

Struct.Description: FINRA ADF MPID Appendage attached when FINRA ADF MPID Appendage Indicator = 2

Struct.Description: BOLO Appendage MPID Form attached when BOLO Appendage Indicator = 5. Adds ADF MPID attribution to the long form fields.

Field.Name: BOLO Bid Price
Field.Description: BOLO Bid Price, 6 implied decimal places

Field.Description: BOLO Best Bid Market Participant Identifier (ADF MPID)

Field.Description: BOLO Best Ask Market Participant Identifier (ADF MPID)

Struct.Name: Odd Lot Price Level Attachment Short Form
Struct.Description: Odd Lot Price Level Attachment Short Form (Odd Lot Attachment Type = 2). Repeats Odd Lot Attachment Count times.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side: B = Bid update, A = Ask update

Field.Name: Odd Lot Price
Field.Description: Odd Lot Price, 2 implied decimal places

Struct.Description: Odd Lot Price Level Attachment Long Form (Odd Lot Attachment Type = 3). Repeats Odd Lot Attachment Count times.

Field.Description: Side: B = Bid update, A = Ask update

Struct.Description: Odd Lot Price Level Attachment ADF MPID Form (Odd Lot Attachment Type = 5). Adds ADF Market Participant Identifier to long form fields. Repeats Odd Lot Attachment Count times.

Field.Description: Side: B = Bid update, A = Ask update

Field.Name: Odd Lot Price
Field.Description: Odd Lot Price, 6 implied decimal places

Field.Name: ADF Market Participant Identifier
Field.Description: ADF Market Participant Identifier (blank if Market Center is not "D")

Group.Name: Market Center Close Recap
Group.Description: Market Center Close Recap attachment following the Session Close Recap Message. Reflects each UTP participant's most recent BBO quote at the market close. Repeats Number of Market Center Attachments times.

Field.Name: Market Center Bid Price
Field.Description: Market Center Bid Price, 6 implied decimal places

Field.Name: Market Center Ask Price
Field.Description: Market Center Ask Price, 6 implied decimal places
